triggerReason: A coherent incident could be detected and traced, but the system still lacked durable alternative explanations, counterevidence, frozen-snapshot falsification, calibrated confidence, and a safe refusal mode.
action: Added versioned hypothesis graphs, four independent diagnostic Agent submissions, provenance-preserving ARIA aggregation, classified evidence, deterministic candidate-removal counterfactuals, confidence/calibration and drift gates, durable diagnosis lifecycle records, authenticated APIs, and an accessible two-density Causal Explorer.
outcome: NEXUS-7 can now state what it believes caused a synthetic incident, what contradicts that belief, what evidence would change it, whether the conclusion survives a replayable falsification test, and why low-trust or low-confidence diagnoses cannot proceed to automated experiments.
evidence: Every diagnosis preserves a leading candidate, at least one alternative, explicit counterevidence, a falsification test and evidence that would change the conclusion
ATLAS, ECONOMICA, CIVITAS and SPECTRE submit independently; ARIA preserves all 60 corpus submissions and disagreements
Evidence remains typed as fact, inference, prediction or human judgment in storage and the Observer
All 45 frozen-snapshot counterfactual runs repeat with exact fingerprints and every leading candidate resolves the declared symptom gate
The 45-sample calibration corpus reaches 100% Top-3 root-cause retrieval with Brier score 0.0602
Injected calibration/model drift selects deterministic fallback; environment/policy drift selects read-only mode
All low-confidence diagnoses remain persisted but ineligible for automated experiments
Memory and PostgreSQL persist diagnosis, calibration, trust and append-only causal events through the shared lifecycle contract
Causal Explorer exposes observer/audit densities, classified evidence, known unknowns, alternatives and counterfactual results without hidden-thought claims
143 standard tests, 8 real PostgreSQL tests, 17 browser/axe scenarios, diagnosis acceptance, production build and inherited model/operations/stress gates pass
